name: Granite-Docling-258M
purpose: Efficient document conversion inside the Docling library (DoclingDocument, DocTags); not meant for general image understanding.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: card "License" section links Apache 2.0 and the metadata says apache-2.0; the HF repo has no separate LICENSE file; the Docling pipeline code (docling-project/docling LICENSE read) is MIT

architecture.kind: Idefics3 vision-language, SigLIP2 encoder, Granite 165M decoder, pixel-shuffle projector
architecture.why_this_design: Consolidates several single-purpose document models into one compact model for Docling; DocTags in fine-tuning data speed convergence (card).

engine_support.notes: card links quantized builds for llama.cpp/Ollama; mtmd support not confirmed on docs page

strengths: Docling integration (PDF text layer plus layout)
weaknesses: hallucination risk grows with small size

tona_fit.reason: smallest option (258M) and Docling handles text PDFs without OCR, but German is not claimed (card lists English plus experimental Japanese, Arabic, Chinese) and no third-party German score exists; as the text-layer/structure branch it stays useful regardless of the VLM.

open_questions: German accuracy: run on our German sample set

pc-16gb.notes: BF16 about 2 GB; Tona runs one model at a time, so it replaces the resident model while it works
